{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during upticks, especially with positive sentiment",
    "True outcomes lead model forecasts during price increases by 1-3 price units",
    "Sentiment positivity amplifies the forecast-actual divergence on upmoves",
    "Model lacks momentum capture, predicting more flat than actual volatility",
    "When prices are declining, model forecasts closely track but remain slightly above reality",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes undershoot on trends in either direction",
    "Sentiment turning positive correlates with maximum forecast-error magnitude"
] }
